outcome: Disorders of calcium and magnesium metabolism
cohort: 1,845 neonates admitted to the NICU at Canakkale Onsekiz Mart University Health Practice and Research Hospital between January 1, 2016, and March 31, 2021.
finding: Endocrine disorders, particularly thyroid disorders, disorders of calcium metabolism, and disorders of glucose homeostasis, were prevalent (14.6%) among neonates admitted to the NICU, with prematurity being a significant contributing factor.
